text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days after the fiercely contested Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).
Word reaches Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It was the news that Sakura Chiyono O, who had run alongside her in the Japanese Derby, was hospitalized with a serious injury and would be stepping away from racing for a while—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—It seems we have everything
needed for the hospital stay without lack.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Ardan-san...
Making you help me out
even though you have training to do—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't be a stranger.
Chiyono O-san took great care of me in the past
when I was in and out of the hospital, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So this is only natural. 'Mutual support is like rice in the same pot'... right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan-san――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …………Um, do you want to step outside for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I don't mind, but won't it be bad for your health...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! Running is off-limits,
but I've been given permission to walk slowly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides...
I won't be at the academy for a while, so...
I just wanted to take in the scenery for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Shall we walk for a little while, then?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder when the next time I'll run on this track will be..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Running in the Japanese Derby
just the other day... feels like a dream now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...It wasn't a dream, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A race where Chiyono O-san, Yaeno-san, and I threw everything we had against each other...
An important, very precious race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A once-in-a-lifetime... race full of memories...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to run alongside
Ardan-san and Yaeno-san…… I……――"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm truly... so glad.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Aah!
It's almost time for my ride to get here...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...!
In that case, shall we grab our things from the dorm and head out?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'll be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Please take care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And also—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's run together again.
Next time, in a race that surpasses even the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As your rival, Chiyono O-san...
I will be waiting for you on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll... do my best!
I won't let it end like this...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Because I want to run more with Ardan-san and Yaeno-san... That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Someday... I will definitely make my comeback! So please... wait for me until then!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...I have faith in you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...It's going to be okay, Chiyono O-san.
I know you'll definitely return to the turf.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Just as you once did for me...
this time, I will be the one to support you and wait for you――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...So Chiyono O has entered the race after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...At the 'Japanese Derby',
I was truly astonished by your and Chiyono O-san's running."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No, I must confess.
You could say I was completely overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Your resolve to bet everything on a single moment.
The way you ran with your whole heart and soul...
It is still burned into my memory."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I fully understand now.
You are, without a doubt, truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Therefore, I have made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
One day, with my own running,
I will head-on defeat both your running
and Chiyono O-san's.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As your... rival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Yaeno-san... believes in me too, doesn't she?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (For Chiyono O to run with us once again—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —I'd like nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall face both you and Chiyono O-san
with all my heart and soul.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...As your rival!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro Ardan shared what happened today with me in the Trainer's Office...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she finishes speaking, a powerful gleam of determination,
stronger than anything seen before,
seems to dwell deep within her eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...There is something new
welling up inside me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I have trained hard and faced races
in order to carve out my own trail of light, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That is not all
that the "current" me seeks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I want to be someone who brings no shame
to Yaeno-san, who sees me as her rival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be someone who won't lose to Chiyono O-san
when she finally returns."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I can feel those very emotions
burning inside me like a raging fire.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Would you please show me the way?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As a rival to you and Chiyono O-san, I want a stage where I can reach even greater heights...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In response to her question,
two different "futures" took shape
in my mind—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One option is entering the long-distance Kikuka Sho,
the final stop on the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki, whom Mejiro Ardan sharply
regards as a rival, is also slated
to run in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If Mejiro Ardan enters, there is no doubt she will be forced into a difficult battle due to the distance..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "However, if the 'current' her clashes with Yaeno Muteki once more, it might pave the way to even greater heights...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The other is the premier medium-distance race where the top Senior-class Umamusume gather:
entering the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that race, certain Umamusume whom one simply cannot ignore
in running in the "present" era should be competing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The names of those Umamusume were
the "Monster" Oguri Cap, and the "White Lightning" Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After transferring from the local circuit to the Central League,
Oguri Cap climbed to the top through an extraordinary winning streak,
becoming a sensation who commands the world's attention today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coincidentally, she was of the same generation as Mejiro Ardan,
making her an Umamusume destined to clash with her sooner or later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Tamamo Cross has torn through the Senior Class on a ferocious winning streak, hailed as the strongest in the nation—the undisputed pinnacle of the "now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Mejiro Ardan, whose goal is to leave an indelible trail of light in the "present,"
there is much she can learn from the one running ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Battling against the two giant stars that shake the era
might just show Mejiro Ardan a brand new realm...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Mejiro Ardan's trainer, the "future" I show her is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The target race has been set to the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...The 'Kikuka Sho'.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And so, you're going to face Yaeno-san once more.
choice_data_list: This is going to be a tough battle.
This is going to be a tough battle, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
However, that was something I was already prepared for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The path I chose is "the most painful and grueling one." It is precisely in fierce battle that the "now" where I can shine exists...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I wonder what will happen the next time I run alongside Yaeno-san.
Just thinking about it makes my heart dance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding our training starting tomorrow...
I look forward to working with you once again,
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The path forward has been set on the Kikuka Sho.
Underneath the night sky, we vowed to push forward with renewed resolve for the battles ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So you'll be fighting there, then.
Against those hailed as the strongest of the "present."
choice_data_list: This is going to be a tough battle.
This is going to be a tough battle, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
However, that was something I was already prepared for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The path I chose is "the most painful and grueling one." It is precisely in fierce battle that the "now" where I can shine exists...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I wonder what kind of running the Senior class runners will face us with.
Just thinking about it makes my heart race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding our training starting tomorrow...
I look forward to working with you once again,
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The path forward has been set on the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Underneath the night sky, we vowed to push forward with renewed resolve for the battles ahead...!
